case_title: SADAKAT KOTWAR AND ANR. v. THE STATE OF JHARKHAND
aggravating_circumstances: Use of deadly weapon, grievous injuries on vital parts of the body
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that the accused stabbed two individuals with a dagger, causing grievous injuries on vital parts of their bodies. The victims were identified as eye-witnesses to the incident. Medical evidence showed that the injuries were severe, with incised wounds on the chest and stomach areas. The accused pushed the victims out of a house and then inflicted the injuries. The prosecution's witnesses, including the victims, supported the case, and the courts below found the accused guilty. The accused did not claim the incident occurred out of a sudden quarrel or in the heat of the moment.
